02 / THE RELATIONSHIP

03 / PARAMETER SPACE

Rest energy versus mass

Snapshots include equations’ inputs, calculated results and graph samples, not private journals. Copy/export important work; experiment inputs are session-only.

Equations, assumptions & references

One invariant mass, several energies.

γ = 1/√(1−v²/c²), E₀ = mc², E = γmc², K = (γ−1)mc², p = γmv. The invariant relation is E² − (pc)² = (mc²)². Here m is always invariant rest mass. E₀ is an energy equivalent, not an extraction efficiency or a promised usable yield.

For a clock at rest in S′, Δt = γΔτ in S. For a rod parallel to the boost, L = L₀/γ; its endpoints must be measured simultaneously in S. These are inertial comparisons, not the apparent visual length in a photograph or a twin-trip calculation.

Frames & limits.

S′ moves at velocity v along S’s x-axis. x′ = γ(x−vt), t′ = γ(t−vx/c²). Velocity addition here is the inverse transformation u = (u′+v)/(1+u′v/c²). We use interval sign convention c²t²−x². Gravity, acceleration, cosmology and quantum effects are outside these six original experiments. The separate 7.0 Equation Bench adds a flat-spacetime proper-acceleration model.

Analytic curves are sampled in double precision. Near light-speed, large values and subtractive cancellation can reduce accuracy. The spacetime plot overlays the coordinate pair of one event in each frame, with a common numerical scale. It is not two events or a full transformed coordinate grid.

References: OpenStax, University Physics, Volume 3, §§5.3–5.6 and 5.8–5.9; NIST CODATA, speed of light in vacuum. Exact reference URLs and numerical notes are included in the source project’s docs/RELATIVITY.md. No reference page is loaded by the app.

The mathematics

H = γL + diag(V)
ℏ = 1
(I + iΔtH/2)ψₙ₊₁ = (I − iΔtH/2)ψₙ

06 / DETERMINISTIC CHAOS

The butterfly driver

LORENZ / RK4

σ = 10 · ρ = 28 · β = 8/3
Classical deterministic dynamics. Not quantum randomness or a measurement of extra dimensions.

The equation grimoire · implemented vs reference
IMPLEMENTED / QUANTUM GRIDi∂ₜψ = [−½∂ₓ² + V(x,t)]ψ

ℏ = m = 1; periodic FFT grid. Strang split-step propagation uses a real potential sampled at the substep midpoint. No renormalization after initialization.

IMPLEMENTED / OUR CHOSEN TOY COUPLINGV = V₀ + 2u sin(2πx/L) + g y(s,t)
+ 2.5χ tanh(Xᴸ/20) cos(4πx/L)
+ A cos(ωt + φ) cos(2πkx/L)

s = (x + L/2)/L; Xᴸ is the Lorenz X coordinate. This one-way bridge is a design choice, not a derived string-theory interaction.

IMPLEMENTED / INPUT FILTERuraw = 2a₀/ADCmax − 1
utarget = clamp(gain · uraw + offset, −1, 1)
u ← u + (utarget − u)(1 − e−Δt/τ)

τ and the USB stale threshold are configurable. A stale USB sample becomes zero raw input before gain/offset mapping. Snapshot hold preserves a normalized raw target and is not live input. A disconnected port never silently becomes a demo stream.

IMPLEMENTED / CLASSICAL MODAL PROXYq̈ⱼ + 2ζq̇ⱼ + ωⱼ²qⱼ + bqⱼ³ = Fⱼ(t)
ωⱼ = jπ√T (open); 2jπ√T (closed)

Six modes in two transverse coordinates; μ = 1, ζ = 0.02, b = 0.8χ. Each coordinate is integrated with RK4. Nonlinearity and forcing are classical toys, not a relativistic worldsheet solution.

IMPLEMENTED / CIRCLE SECTOR ONLYpL,R = n/R ± wR/α′
M²compact = (n/R)² + (wR/α′)²
(R,n,w) ↔ (α′/R,w,n)

With α′ = 1 in this calculator. This is a contribution to the closed-string mass squared, not the complete physical spectrum. Independent of the Schrödinger toy.

IMPLEMENTED / LORENZ DRIVEẊ = 10(Y−X)
Ẏ = X(28−Z)−Y
Ż = XY−(8/3)Z

Its bounded projection supplies an external drive. Chaotic input is not evidence for chaotic growth of the quantum norm.

REFERENCE ONLY / NAMBU–GOTOSNG = −T ∫ d²σ √(−det γ)
γab = ∂aXμ ∂bXμ

The action measures worldsheet area in a flat target spacetime. It is not minimized or quantized by this app.

REFERENCE ONLY / POLYAKOVSP = −(T/2) ∫ d²σ √(−h) hab ∂aXμ ∂bXμ

h is an independent worldsheet metric, unlike the induced metric γ. In conformal gauge the flat-space equations include (∂²τ−∂²σ)Xμ = 0, plus constraints. The canvas does not enforce those constraints. See David Tong, String Theory, chapters 1 and 8 (arXiv:0908.0333).

Fork controls: V(x,t), wave packet & Arduino mapping

Vextra(x,t) = A cos(ωt + φ) cos(2πkx/L)

An optional real, periodic modulation added to the existing potential. Bounded coefficients, no executable formula strings. This chosen toy interaction is not fundamental string theory.

Initial packet parameters below apply on Reset waves, not while editing an evolved wave.

raw = 2·a0/adcMax − 1
target = clamp(gain·raw + offset, −1, 1)
u ← u + (target − u)(1 − exp(−Δt/τ))

A0 is the included firmware channel. Mapping also applies to demo, manual and held input. A stale USB stream has raw input 0; a configured offset may still produce a nonzero target.

Your share link

Link destination & reproducibility

Blank destination creates a goblinkaos://experiment/ link for this Android preview. Some messaging apps do not make custom-scheme links clickable; paste the complete link into Import instead. HTTPS links require a real hosted copy of the supplied HTML. Entering a URL does not deploy or upload anything. Loopback links work on your own computer only.

A link restores a validated checkpoint paused, including phase, not merely a look-alike density. Demo/manual continuation is deterministic within the same engine, subject to floating-point differences across platforms. USB checkpoints load as visibly labeled held input: future hardware samples are not part of the snapshot. Visual history restarts.

Browser file export is available. This minimal Android host uses copy/paste JSON rather than a native file picker or native sharing bridge. Anyone with a link can read and modify its data; author labels are not signatures.

Protocol and hardware boundaries

New interchange: dreamflex.sensor.v1, one JSON object per line, A0 integer value and ADC maximum, sequence and device milliseconds. The retained Kaos v1 format is also accepted. Desktop serial uses 115200 baud and an explicit device chooser.

This preview does not implement Android USB/Bluetooth, detect sleep stages, control a mask, or write commands to hardware. Compatibility with earlier DreamFlex firmware is unknown without its actual protocol. The included Arduino sketch emits testable generic A0 readings only.

Clock, carrier & initial conditions Edits require a session rebuild
Bridge Δt is dimensionless. Kaos, wave, resonator and synchrony advance 1 model unit per bridge unit. MD advances 0.2τ, using fixed 0.001τ substeps. This is a chosen conversion, not a physical identification of their clocks.

 

  
The equations behind the links
A causal signal bus
s = normalized observable at tick k
q = s delayed by d extra ticks
z ← z + [1 − exp(−Δt / τfilter)] (q − z)
u = clamp(base + Σ gain × z, port limits)
Sources are sampled before any engine advances. Every target holds its input for one bridge interval, so feedback has no instantaneous algebraic loop. New or edited links reset their filter and use the current source as constant prehistory. Disabled links go to zero immediately.
Driven oscillator
ẍ + 2ζω₀ẋ + ω₀²x + αx³
 = Fcarrier sin(ωcarrier t) + uforce
Molecular shear
Fext,i,x = A [sin(2πzi/L) − mean sin(2πz/L)]
Fext,i,y = Fext,i,z = 0
Δvᵢ = h Fext,ᵢ / mᵢ
Wkick = Σᵢ mᵢ(vᵢ Δvᵢ + ½Δvᵢ²)
External half-kicks surround each internal velocity-Verlet step. Net external force is zero. Work is the exact kinetic-energy change of those kicks; internal integration error is still possible. No heat bath or equilibrium pressure claim is added.
A wave shaped by the bus
i∂ψ/∂t = [−½∂²/∂x² + H exp(−x²/2)]ψ
128 periodic grid points, split-step FFT, ħ=m=1. Norm is monitored without renormalization. Changing H supplies external driving; no wave-energy conservation claim is made. The nonlinear oscillator, Lorenz flow and phase ensemble use RK4.
Resonance, correlation, synchronization and chaos are distinct. A frequency peak or a similar-looking trace does not establish causal physics or an asymptotic Lyapunov exponent. The inter-lab mappings are deliberately chosen educational couplings.

The equations under the glass
U(r) = 4ε[(σ/r)¹² − (σ/r)⁶]
Uₛ(r) = U(r) − U(r꜀) − (r−r꜀)U′(r꜀)
Fᵢ = −∇ᵢ Σ Uₛ(rᵢⱼ)

Uᵦ(r) = ½k(r−r₀)²   [dimers only]

r(t+h) = r(t) + h v(t) + ½h² F(t)/m
v(t+h) = v(t) + h[F(t)+F(t+h)]/(2m)

T = 2Kthermal / [(3N−3)kB]
P = [2Kthermal + Σ rᵢⱼ · Fᵢⱼ] / (3V)
MSD = ⟨|Δrᵢ − ΔR_COM|²⟩
ΔR_COM = ΣᵢmᵢΔrᵢ / Σᵢmᵢ
Three dimensions. Explicit assumptions.
Generic mode uses σ₀ = ε₀ = m₀ = kB = 1. Element mode uses m₀ = 1 u and each bead’s listed mass. Length σ₀ and energy ε₀ are unspecified reference scales; time τ₀ = σ₀√(m₀/ε₀). Individual species σ and ε are editable coefficients, not these reference units. A periodic cube uses minimum-image nonbonded distances and a cutoff strictly below L/2. Potential and force go continuously to zero at the cutoff.
Fluid starts on a slightly jittered FCC lattice. Dimers are permanent, flexible two-bead molecules on seeded orientations. Bonded partners have harmonic forces instead of LJ; no rigid constraints remove degrees of freedom. These are generic beads, not a calibrated real substance.
Plain velocity Verlet, no thermostat or barostat. No Coulomb forces, reactions, bond breaking, water model, proteins, or quantum effects. Pressure includes bonded and nonbonded virial terms with center-of-mass velocity removed. No tail corrections.
g(r) uses spherical shells, all nonbonded pairs within L/2, and finite-N normalization. Bonded partners are excluded. It averages accepted snapshots, including the initial lattice, until you reset observations. MSD uses unwrapped positions with center-of-mass drift removed. No automatic diffusion coefficient or phase classification is claimed.
Bounded CPU work, at most 50,000 steps. A close pair, overextended bond or excessive step displacement halts at the last accepted state. Energy drift is scaled by max(Nε, |E at observation reset|), not E alone.
Method references: LAMMPS documentation for force-shifted LJ, velocity Verlet, harmonic bonds, RDF, MSD and pressure. This is an independent teaching implementation, not LAMMPS itself.

 
A REAL MID-RUN RESTART
Keep the motion.
Checkpoint JSON preserves coordinates, velocities, inputs and the current step. Restore resumes that numerical state, paused, with fresh diagnostic baselines. Recipes rebuild the start instead. Exports open copyable text; neither format is a full workspace backup.

The fixed C/Si parameter set is Tersoff (1989), with its erratum, transcribed from LAMMPS SiC.tersoff. Analytical forces include angular and environmental derivatives. Velocity Verlet integrates in Å, fs, eV and u. No permanent spring list, octet rule or distance-only bond creation is used.
This is a limited empirical solid-state potential, not universal chemistry, quantum electronic structure, charge transfer, water synthesis or radioactive decay. Model accuracy depends on material and conditions. The attractive-pair seed starts inside the interaction cutoff with negative energy; the separation seed deliberately adds an outward kick. Neither is a prediction that two isolated atoms must form a stable molecule on collision.
No artificial damping removes reaction energy. Dynamics may scatter, vibrate, rearrange or retain a structure. The reactive engine is independent of the older illustrative Matter 3D and Resonance engines; it is not secretly substituted into their checkpoints or cross-module links.

A science capsule is not an encrypted backup. It never includes Vault text, Field notes or DreamFlex journals. A SHA-256 receipt checks the payload against its included digest, not the identity of its author or the truth of its results. A changed payload with a newly calculated digest can pass.

Your notes.
Your key.
Explicit controls, established cryptography, and boundaries you can inspect.
⌑

 
Vault only. Encryption applies to this notebook and its sealed exports. Older Field notes, DreamFlex journals, simulation memory and ordinary exports are not automatically encrypted. This is not device encryption or protection from a compromised operating system.

 

 

 
01 / PRIVATE NOTEBOOK
Sentinel Vault

  
Use a unique passphrase of at least 15 characters. There is no recovery key or reset backdoor. Forgotten passphrases mean lost access.

  
Save before locking or backgrounding. Unsaved edits are discarded on lock. Capturing an export copies text; its original remains outside the vault.

  
Backgrounding always seals the vault. This drops key references and clears its visible text, not a guaranteed memory wipe or a lock on the other labs.

 
02 / REVIEW BEFORE REPLACEMENT
Restore a sealed capsule
Re-enter the capsule passphrase above to apply. Notes, journals and simulations are not replaced.

 
03 / EVIDENCE RECEIPT
Check exact text
SHA-256 detects a mismatch against a trusted reference. A hash is not a signature, proof of authorship, or proof that the science is correct.

 
Threat model & remaining gaps
The vault is designed to protect a copied ciphertext from reading or modification without its passphrase. It does not authenticate an external sender, prevent an older valid capsule being replayed, or protect plaintext while unlocked from malicious scripts, extensions, keyboards, screen cameras, root access or a compromised host.
The Android source requests FLAG_SECURE and rejects obscured touches, disables backups/debugging, has no permissions or JavaScript/native bridge, and ignores incoming URI data. These are code-level controls, not runtime attestation. Hardware-backed keystores, secure boot, kernel hardening, sandboxed modules, signed updates, independent penetration testing and FIPS certification are not implemented or established here.
All inherited JavaScript modules still share a single WebView. Chaos equations are never used for encryption keys. The cryptographic provider must supply AES-GCM and PBKDF2 in a secure context; otherwise the vault refuses to work. Standard crypto primitives do not make a custom application automatically secure.

 
Session security events / no notebook contents
Volatile local event list, not a tamper-resistant audit trail. It resets when the page closes.

    What the geometry and measurements mean
    The live graph
    Nodes represent TRIScore application modules and their instrumented subengines in this browser, not native operating-system processes. Solid signal edges come from accepted Resonance routes. Dashed edges are declared transfer paths or configured Kaos couplings, not proof of a completed transfer. Event pulses report observed navigation, control requests, or app events. No journal, password, or Tris memory text is inspected.
    The component count and cycle rank describe the current filtered graph after directions and duplicate pairs are removed. Display motion does not measure an OS-wide Lyapunov exponent.
    The attractor & sensitivity
    The reference flow integrates the Lorenz equations (σ=10, ρ=28, β=8/3) with RK4 at Δt=0.005. A tangent vector is integrated and renormalized each step; its logarithmic growth is averaged after 10 model-time units of burn-in. A 30-unit warm start provides the initial trace. λ̂ belongs to this reference model. Nexus and Frontier estimates appear on their own node when available.
    Select Live Resonance Lorenz to trace the coupled engine's actual coordinates at up to five observations per second, retaining 1,000 points. Dock the monitor while running Resonance. No Lyapunov rate is inferred from those samples. Node placement along either path is a visual mapping; lab equations and timesteps stay in their own engines.
    Calabi–Yau geometry
    The Fermat quintic is Z₀⁵+Z₁⁵+Z₂⁵+Z₃⁵+Z₄⁵=0 in CP⁴. Here Z₀=1 and Z₃=Z₄=0, leaving 1+z₁⁵+z₂⁵=0. We sample five root sheets of that real two-dimensional slice and project four real coordinates into three. Gaps at chart branch cuts are omitted mesh connections, not boundaries of the whole manifold.
    The optional harmonic loops solve a periodic one-dimensional wave equation before an illustrative embedding into the slice. No Ricci-flat metric, Nambu–Goto evolution, compactification dynamics, or physical string-theory prediction is computed.
    The atomic lens
    Positions come directly from the accepted Matter 3D checkpoint. Edges show candidate neighbors inside its global cutoff, plus declared harmonic dimer bonds. They are not inferred chemical bonds or a per-pair force measurement; species-specific interactions may differ. At most 128 particles and 1,200 edges are shown, with truncation reported. Neighbor distances use periodic minimum images; line positions use the wrapped display box.
    Snapshots are explicit, unencrypted telemetry exports. Browser storage and Tris vaults are not changed by observing. Sentinel sealing clears recent observations and pauses this view.
